execution.ref: GRAPHITE-RUNNER-USABILITY-01 (.agent/decisions/2026-10-05-GRAPHITE-RUNNER-USABILITY-01.md), branch claude/graphite-runner-usability; operator findings B6, B9, B11, C7, C8 and C9 from the Graphite Launchpad findings.
execution.description: Six runner usability fixes: per-pod booked versus charged or estimated money with its basis, a typed next step for a terminal reconciliation_required session, phase 4's coverage report and B2 written once under the run root, one key-file credential option across phases, --challenge errors that list the accepted tokens, and a supported run-checked wrapper for gates, launch and post-run checks.

expected: An operator, human or agent, can launch a Graphite session, read what it cost and know what to do next from the runners' own output, without bespoke scripts or reading the code.
observed: Every pod read as booked at its full reservation with no estimate beside it; the ticket said rerun for a session that is terminal; the coverage report and B2 existed only on stdout; phase 3 and phase 4 took the Engy key in different ways; a missing --challenge did not say which tokens exist; and executors wrote their own launch scripts.
keep: A runner's output separates what counts against a cap (booked) from what the provider charged and from an estimate, and names the basis for each number.
A terminal state's output names the next command, so neither a person nor an agent reruns a command that only reprints the end.
A required selection is never defaulted; the usage error lists the accepted values instead.
change: Every report a runner prints that a later step reads is also written once under the run root at a stable path.
A supported wrapper composes the existing gate, launch and post-run commands; executors stop writing per-run launch scripts.
